title: Fairfax Forward Foundation to host lasagna dinner fundraiser and silent auction July 20
text:
Fairfax Forward Foundation to host lasagna dinner fundraiser and silent auction July 20
The Fairfax Forward Foundation will hold its Lasagna Dinner Fundraiser and Silent Auction on July 20, offering an evening of food, community, and support for local businesses. The event is scheduled from 6:00 to 8:00 PM at The Oakton Tasting Room at Settle Down Easy Brewery.
Attendees can expect a homemade lasagna dinner, a fresh Caesar salad, rolls and butter, dessert, and one complimentary drink ticket. Guests may choose between meat lasagna with red sauce or veggie lasagna with white sauce. Tickets are priced at $40 per person.
The silent auction will feature items donated by Chamber members and local businesses, including gift certificates, exclusive experiences, professional services, and specialty items. "The silent auction is a chance to 'sample' the incredible products and services offered by your fellow Chamber members. You may just find your new favorite restaurant, service provider, or business partner!" according to the Central Fairfax Chamber of Commerce.
Proceeds from the event will support the Fairfax Forward Foundation's mission to strengthen the Central Fairfax business community through various programs and initiatives. "Every ticket purchased and every winning bid helps the Foundation continue its work of advancing the Central Fairfax business community through impactful programs and initiatives," the Chamber said.
Those unable to attend in person can participate in the silent auction online until July 20 at 8 PM. More information and registration details are available on the event website.
